description: Defines the PaymentMethod class, representing a payment method with associated metadata and configurations used within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: A model class representing a payment method, including identifiers, type, module, configuration, and selection status.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Returns the payment type associated with this payment method.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment type for this payment method.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifying this payment method.

methods.name: setPaymentMethodCode
methods.description: Sets the code for this payment method.

methods.name: isDefaultSelected
methods.description: Indicates whether this payment method is the default selection.

methods.name: setDefaultSelected
methods.description: Sets the default selection status for this payment method.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the integration module associated with this payment method.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the integration module for this payment method.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Returns the integration configuration information for this payment method.

methods.name: setInformations
methods.description: Sets the integration configuration information for this payment method.
